Accessibility

Last updated: 17 November 2026

We want everyone to be able to use Relay, including people who use a screen reader, a keyboard only, zoom or other assistive technology.

What we do

  • Relay aims to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA.
  • Everything works with a keyboard. Ctrl/⌘+K jumps to any chat, Alt+↑/↓ moves between chats, Esc closes dialogs.
  • Buttons and controls have text labels for screen readers, and new messages and notices are announced.
  • Light and dark themes, text size from 85% to 125%, larger message text, reduced motion, and a Simple mode with bigger text and buttons and fewer options.
  • Voice messages can be transcribed to text, and messages can be read aloud.

Known limitations

  • Relay is in English only for now; French and Arabic (with right-to-left layout) are planned.
  • Some games are visual and don't yet have full screen-reader descriptions of the board.
  • Videos from YouTube depend on YouTube's own player and captions.

Feedback

If something is hard to use, tell us and we'll fix it: github.com/Anas2103/Relay/issues.
